title: Exodus 3:2 — The burning bush, not consumed
summary: Exodus 3:2 in English with the Hebrew reference header: the angel of the LORD appears in a blazing fire from the midst of a bush, and the bush burns yet is not consumed. The word bush is highlighted in green and two letters of LORD are coloured.

text.text: 2 The angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from the midst of a bush; and he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, yet the bush was not consumed.

uncertain: Moses is not named on the slide; 'him' refers to him in context. Only the L and R of LORD are coloured (brown, orange); meaning not stated.
